description: Loop backlog seed (improvement list L44): the open AutoDev queue from the 8 November improvement list, in order. scripts/loop/seed-issues.mjs turns each entry into a loop-item issue. needsTim entries are created with loop:needs-tim instead of loop:candidate, so the loop leaves them until Tim decides. Details for each item are in the improvement list under its code.

items.title: Maths property tests for number lines, Venn, cuboids, triangles and value graphs
acceptance: Seeded property tests (src/testing/random.ts forAll) for: number-line tick and interval arithmetic stays exact; Venn regions partition the universe; cuboid unit-cube count equals l x w x h; triangle angles sum to 180 and side labels do not overlap; value-graph table values agree with plotted points.
No production code changes; every test passes with the default seed and with PROPERTY_RUNS=20.

items.title: Keyboard-path smoke for every tool
acceptance: For each of the 11 tools, tabbing reaches every visible control, each has an accessible name, focus is visible on screen.
Covers the tools #108 and #114 did not; no production code changes.

items.title: Undo coverage: every editing action can be undone in one step
acceptance: A registry lists each tool's editing actions, and a test applies each action then one undo and checks the document is unchanged.
A new action missing from the registry fails the test.

items.title: One File menu, the same in every tool
acceptance: Every tool's File menu has the same items in the same order, defined once.
The hidden-answers note under Save editable file appears in every tool that saves hidden answers.
e2e/consistency.spec.ts asserts the order in all 11 tools.

items.title: Consistent, dismissible hint lines
acceptance: One shared hint slot in the same place in every tool, dismissible permanently (localStorage, wrapped in try/catch).
Hints never appear in exports; export goldens unchanged.

items.title: Two-step Reset with a visible Undo
acceptance: Reset in every tool shows 'Resource reset' with an Undo action, and Undo restores the document exactly.
An e2e test checks this in all 11 tools.

items.title: Meaningful filenames on downloads
acceptance: Downloads are named mathsdock-<tool>-<short-content>-<date>.<ext>, built by one shared helper.
The file contents are unchanged (export goldens identical).

items.title: A visible 'Saved to file' check after Save editable file
acceptance: After Save editable file, the menu shows a short 'Saved to file' confirmation that screen readers announce.
Nothing changes in the saved file or exports.

items.title: Bigger direct-edit targets for touch screens
acceptance: Invisible hit areas for number-line ticks, Venn regions and labels, triangle vertices and value-graph cells are at least 44 px; visible marks keep their size.
Export goldens and screenshots of exports unchanged; axe shows no new violations.

items.title: Windows high-contrast support for the editor chrome
acceptance: forced-colors rules make selection, pressed buttons and editing guides visible as outlines in high-contrast mode.
Normal-mode screenshots unchanged.

items.title: Thousands separators in question counts
acceptance: Every question count on the bank and paper builder pages uses toLocaleString('en-GB') (2,375).
A unit test covers the formatting.

items.title: Fix the double focus jump in dev StrictMode
acceptance: The route-focus effect is safe under StrictMode's double run: the first Tab on the home page reaches 'Skip to content' in dev and production.
A test covers it.

items.title: Report an invalid question view instead of clamping it
acceptance: readRoute uses 1-based views throughout and reports an invalid view instead of silently clamping it.
Existing links keep opening the same view.

items.title: Name the failing question when the catalogue cannot be read
acceptance: verifyCatalogue keeps the teacher-facing message and also logs the question ID and field that failed.
A test covers one failure.

items.title: Consistent Delete and arrow-key nudging in every tool
acceptance: A shared keymap: Delete removes, arrows nudge (Shift for larger steps), Esc deselects, Tab cycles objects.
Needs Tim's spec of what each object type does first.

items.title: Consistent example-card buttons and teacher-facing blurbs
acceptance: One primary button label across tools; bar-model blurbs give a teacher-facing purpose; captions use proper minus signs.
The blurb wording needs Tim's voice.

items.title: Inspector beside the resource on tablets
acceptance: At 768 px and wider the diagram stays in view while settings are edited.
Needs Tim's layout choice (side drawer, bottom sheet or two columns).
